# Review of domain plausibility

## Summary

The draft describes NASA POWER's monthly temperature at one grid cell, tests for a trend on the training years, and compares a trend-and-season model with naive and seasonal naive forecasts on a hold-out fixed in advance.

## Points to address

1. A warming of about 0.7 degrees C per decade is high but within what regional assessments report for central Europe since 2000; say so with a source.
2. Note that 2022 and 2023 were unusually warm years in the hold-out.

## DIMENSION SCORES
- Overall: 8/10

OVERALL SCORE: 8/10
RECOMMENDATION: Minor Revision
